description: A resolver that returns null rather than throwing, so the failing exception is manufactured by the library on the callback's behalf at DefaultStrings.java:1169-1171. Both en catalogs use a phonetic placeholder over the same caller value but under DIFFERENT generated-placeholder names, so the two candidates fail with the same exception TYPE and the same inner message, and differ only in their contextualized wrapper -- which makes first-cause retention answerable by message alone. Two loaded locales share 'en', so tiebreakers is mandatory.
